translation_direction: ru → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Russian electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: The narrator is chúng tôi, with his hedges, failing memory, digressions and mock-solemn asides kept in place.
decisions.rationale: Gogol’s narrating voice is the story’s comedy and its pathos.

decisions.decision: Akaky and Petrovich: ngài/tôi; the Significant Person to Akaky: ông; the ghost to the Significant Person: mày/tao; «Я брат твой» as Tôi là người anh em của anh.
decisions.rationale: Register marks the social distances the story is about.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Akaky’s tic того switched to cái đó in the second half, including the ghost’s climactic line; now cái ấy throughout.
капот became áo choàng cũ in the second half, breaking the «уже известный читателю капот» callback; now áo choàng ngủ throughout.
тайные советники rendered as a rank class contradicting the советник chain of 1.4; now cố vấn cơ mật, with cố vấn hàm cửu phẩm in 1.4 and 1.35.
столоначальник typo (trưởng ban) corrected; надзиратель no longer a school ‘giám thị’; будочник, сторож, грош and sâm-banh unified.

Mechanical repetition of một nhân vật quan trọng reduced to Gogol’s одно; viên chức-người chết replaced; lowercase after exclamation normalised; 1.28 toast and 1.3 «новому или важному лицу» rephrased.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The story turns on the contrast between the new greatcoat and the old coat the office mocks as a капот; the two terms are never mixed.
One rendering for all nineteen instances, including the narrator naming the tic and the ghost’s «я тебя того, поймал».
A fixed epithet in all twenty-two occurrences; the indefinite một is kept only where Gogol writes одно.

glossary.draft_rendering: cố vấn/viên chức hàm cửu phẩm; cố vấn cơ mật; trưởng bàn; người gác chòi canh
glossary.rationale: Table-of-Ranks terms are rendered by class so that the советник pun in 1.4 lands; office and police terms are fixed.

witness_decision: Selected the Russian Wikisource page «Шинель (Гоголь)/ПСС 1938 (СО)» (revision 5631032), whose source is Н. В. Гоголь, Полное собрание сочинений, vol. 3 (1938), pp. 139–174, via FEB, in modern orthography. Wikisource marks its quality 3; a second transcription (СС 1967) has the same long paragraphing. First published in Сочинения Николая Гоголя, vol. 3 (1842); not collated.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The barracks rhyme «пряжку в петлицу / геморой в поясницу» is not reproduced as rhyme.
Petrovich’s substandard «судырь» and «Здравствовать желаю» are only lightly marked.
hồn ma viên chức softens the corpse’s physicality of чиновник-мертвец.

title_review.rationale: Chiếc áo khoác is the established Vietnamese title; áo khoác is broader than шинель, but áo choàng is reserved for the капот so that the old/new coat contrast stays clear.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Naming scene and calendar names complete.
«Оставьте меня» and «Я брат твой» kept with weight.
Ghost ending complete, including the snuff, the pig and the Obukhov bridge.
